question: During the Basic Control Skills test exercises, you will be scored for pull-ups, encroachments, looks, and final position. Which of the following is NOT one of these scored items?
choice_a: Encroachments
choice_b: Looks
choice_c: Pull-ups
explanation: The manual states you will be scored for pull-ups, encroachments, looks, and final position during the Basic Control Skills exercises. Fuel efficiency is not part of this scoring.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What is scored as a "pull-up" during the Basic Control Skills test?
choice_a: Exiting the vehicle to check its position
choice_b: Pulling forward on a backing exercise to clear an encroachment or get a better position
choice_c: Touching a boundary cone with the vehicle's mirror
explanation: The manual defines a pull-up as pulling forward on a backing exercise to clear an encroachment or to get a better position. Stopping without changing direction does not count as a pull-up.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: Which two exercises include scoring for "pull-ups"?
choice_a: Exercise 1 and Exercise 4
choice_b: Exercise 3 and Exercise 4
choice_c: Exercise 1 and Exercise 3
explanation: Pull-ups are scored on Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing and Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: Will you be penalized for an initial pull-up during a backing exercise?
choice_a: Only during the Road Test
choice_b: No, but an excessive number of pull-ups will count as errors
choice_c: Yes, every pull-up is penalized
choice_d: Only if it occurs on Exercise 2
explanation: The manual states you will not be penalized for initial pull-ups; however, an excessive number of pull-ups will count as errors.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: How does the manual define an "encroachment" during a Basic Control Skills exercise?
choice_a: Only crossing the outer boundary line, never a cone
choice_b: Only touching the boundary with a tire
choice_c: Touching or crossing over an exercise boundary line or cone with any part of the vehicle other than the mirrors or unique parts at/above door mirror height
explanation: An encroachment is touching or crossing over an exercise boundary line or cone with any part of the vehicle other than the mirrors (door or fender) or other unique vehicle parts at or higher than door mirror height. Unique parts below door mirror height ARE counted as an encroachment.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: If you encroach during a Basic Control Skills exercise, what must you do?
choice_a: Ask the examiner for a restart
choice_b: Stop immediately when signaled by the examiner and return the vehicle within the exercise boundaries
choice_c: Immediately fail the exercise
choice_d: Continue the exercise and correct it at the end
explanation: If you have encroached, the examiner will stop you and you must return the vehicle within the exercise boundaries; you must stop immediately when signaled.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What is scored as a "look" during a backing exercise?
choice_a: Checking your mirrors while backing
choice_b: Asking the examiner a question before starting
choice_c: Opening the door or moving from a seated position to check the vehicle's external position
explanation: If you open the door or move from a seated position (or, on a bus, walk to the back to get a better view) while performing an exercise, you will be scored for a look.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: Before exiting the vehicle to take a "look" during a backing exercise, what must you do?
choice_a: Roll down all windows
choice_b: Turn off the engine completely
choice_c: Set the parking brake(s) and place the vehicle in neutral/park
explanation: When taking a look, you must set the parking brake(s) and place the vehicle in neutral/park before safely exiting/entering the vehicle.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: How many points of contact with the vehicle must you maintain when exiting/entering it (non-bus) during an exercise?
choice_a: Four
choice_b: Three
choice_c: One
explanation: You must safely exit/enter by facing the vehicle and maintaining three (3) points of contact at all times.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: On a bus, when exiting/entering the vehicle during an exercise, what should you do instead of the standard three points of contact facing the vehicle?
choice_a: Exit backward while holding the steering wheel
choice_b: There is no special procedure for buses
choice_c: Jump directly from the driver's seat
choice_d: Face forward and maintain a firm grasp on the handrail
explanation: When entering/exiting a bus, you face forward and maintain a firm grasp on the handrail.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What happens if you open your vehicle's door while it is still moving (not in neutral/park) during a Basic Control Skills exercise?
choice_a: It may result in an automatic failure for an unsafe act
choice_b: Nothing, as long as you close it quickly
choice_c: It only counts as a look, with no other consequence
choice_d: You must restart only that exercise
explanation: If you open your door while the vehicle is moving (not in neutral and park), it may result in an automatic failure for an unsafe act.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: How many free looks are allowed on Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing?
choice_a: One
choice_b: Two
choice_c: Zero
explanation: You may be allowed a maximum of one (1) free look on Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: How many free looks are allowed on Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing?
choice_a: Three
choice_b: Unlimited
choice_c: One
explanation: You may be allowed a maximum of two (2) free looks on Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

topic: Basic Control Skills Scoring - Final Position
question: On which exercises will you be scored for the "final position" of the vehicle?
choice_a: All four exercises
choice_b: Exercise 2 and Exercise 4
choice_c: Exercise 1 and Exercise 3
explanation: You will be scored for final vehicle position on Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing and Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

topic: Basic Control Skills Scoring - Completion Procedure
question: What must you do upon completion of a Basic Control Skills exercise?
choice_a: Immediately proceed to the next exercise without stopping
choice_b: Turn off the engine and wait silently
choice_c: Set the parking brake, place the vehicle in neutral/park, and sound the horn
choice_d: Honk twice and immediately exit the vehicle
explanation: Upon completion of an exercise, set the parking brake, place the vehicle in neutral/park, and sound the horn indicating you have completed the exercise.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

topic: Basic Control Skills Scoring - Unsafe Act
question: Which of the following could result in an automatic failure for an "unsafe act" during the Basic Control Skills test?
choice_a: Taking slightly longer than expected to complete an exercise
choice_b: Using an allowed free pull-up
choice_c: Asking the examiner a clarifying question
choice_d: Forgetting to set the parking brake or opening the door while the vehicle is in motion
explanation: Committing an unsafe act, such as forgetting to set the parking brake or opening the door while in motion, may result in an automatic failure and the test may be terminated.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

topic: Basic Control Skills Scoring - Unsafe Act
question: What happens if you fail to follow the examiner's instructions for completing an exercise as directed?
choice_a: You are given one warning before continuing
choice_b: Points are deducted only from the written test score
choice_c: It may result in automatic failure and the test may be terminated
choice_d: You simply repeat the exercise with no penalty
explanation: Failure to follow examiner instructions for completing the exercise as directed may result in an automatic failure and the test may be terminated by the examiner.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What is the correct order of the four Basic Control Skills exercises as listed in the manual?
choice_a: Forward Offset Tracking, Forward Stop, Reverse Offset Backing, Straight-Line Backing
choice_b: Reverse Offset Backing, Forward Stop, Straight-Line Backing, Forward Offset Tracking
choice_c: Forward Stop, Straight-Line Backing, Forward Offset Tracking, Reverse Offset Backing
choice_d: Straight-Line Backing, Forward Stop, Reverse Offset Backing, Forward Offset Tracking
explanation: The manual lists the steps as: Step 1 - Forward Stop, Step 2 - Straight-Line Backing, Step 3 - Forward Offset Tracking, and Step 4 - Reverse Offset Backing.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, Introduction

topic: Basic Control Skills / Road Test Sequencing
question: According to the manual, what must happen before a candidate can proceed to the Road Test?
choice_a: Waiting 24 hours after the vehicle inspection
choice_b: Completing a written re-test
choice_c: Passing the Basic Control Skills test
choice_d: Nothing; the Road Test may be taken first
explanation: The manual states, "Remember, the Basic Control Skills test must be passed before you can proceed to the Road Test."
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, Exercise 4/Road Test note

question: What must you do to complete Exercise 1 - Forward Stop?
choice_a: Drive forward through the alley and stop with the front of the vehicle within the box at the end without going past it
choice_b: Drive forward and stop only when signaled by another driver on the road
choice_c: Parallel park within a marked box
choice_d: Back through the alley and stop before the cones
explanation: In Exercise 1, you drive forward through the alley and stop with the front most part of the vehicle within the box at the end of the alley without going past it.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.1 Exercise 1

question: How many times may you stop during Exercise 1 - Forward Stop?
choice_a: As many times as needed
choice_b: Up to two times
choice_c: Up to three times
explanation: The manual states, "You may stop only once" during Exercise 1 - Forward Stop.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.1 Exercise 1

question: In Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing, you must back the vehicle straight through the alley until:
choice_a: The rear of the vehicle touches the boundary line
choice_b: You have backed exactly 100 feet
choice_c: The front of your vehicle has cleared the last set of cones at the far end of the alley
explanation: You back straight through the alley until the front of your vehicle has cleared the last set of cones at the far end of the alley.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.2 Exercise 2

question: How many free pull-ups are allowed on Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing?
choice_a: Three
choice_b: Zero
choice_c: One
explanation: You are allowed one (1) free pull-up on Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.2 Exercise 2

question: During Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing, how many times may you safely exit the vehicle to check around it?
choice_a: Zero times
choice_b: Two times
choice_c: As many times as needed
explanation: You may safely exit the vehicle only one (1) time to check around the vehicle during Exercise 2.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.2 Exercise 2

question: What does Exercise 3 - Forward Offset Tracking test?
choice_a: Your ability to perform an emergency stop
choice_b: Your ability to maneuver a vehicle around other objects while moving forward without stopping
choice_c: Your ability to parallel park within three feet of a curb
choice_d: Your ability to back the vehicle around obstacles
explanation: Exercise 3 demonstrates your ability to maneuver a vehicle around other objects while moving forward without stopping.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.3 Exercise 3

question: In Exercise 3, as you steer left through the opening into the opposite lane without stopping, what must you keep between the cone and the line?
choice_a: The vehicle's mirror
choice_b: The trailer's landing gear
choice_c: The right most rear tire
explanation: You drive forward and steer left through the opening into the opposite lane, keeping the right most rear tire between the cone and the line without stopping.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.3 Exercise 3

question: What happens if you stop during Exercise 3 - Forward Offset Tracking?
choice_a: The exercise will be ended
choice_b: Nothing; stopping is permitted in this exercise
choice_c: You must reverse back to the start
explanation: You are NOT allowed to stop, back up, or exit the vehicle during Exercise 3. If you stop, the exercise will be ended.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.3 Exercise 3

question: Exercise 3 - Forward Offset Tracking is scored for which two things?
choice_a: Looks and pull-ups
choice_b: Final position and looks
choice_c: Pull-ups and final position
explanation: You will be scored for encroachments and forward tracking clearance (rear tire between the cone and the line) in Exercise 3.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.3 Exercise 3

question: In Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing, how close must the rear most part of the vehicle come to the rear of the alley?
choice_a: Within three (3) feet
choice_b: It must touch the rear boundary exactly
choice_c: Within ten (10) feet
explanation: You must offset back into the alley, bringing the rear most part of your vehicle within three (3) feet of the rear of the alley, stopping in the three-foot box.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.4 Exercise 4

question: If you back beyond the rear boundary of the alley during Exercise 4, what must you do?
choice_a: Continue backing until told to stop
choice_b: Restart the entire Basic Control Skills test
choice_c: Pull straight forward past the alley entrance until signaled by the examiner to stop, then resume the exercise
explanation: If you back beyond the rear boundary of the alley, you must pull straight forward past the alley entrance until signaled by the examiner to stop, prior to resuming the exercise.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.4 Exercise 4

question: How many free pull-ups are allowed on Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing?
choice_a: One
choice_b: Three
choice_c: None
explanation: You are allowed two (2) free pull-ups on Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.4 Exercise 4

question: During Exercise 4, how many times may you exit the vehicle to check around it?
choice_a: A maximum of one time
choice_b: A maximum of three times
choice_c: Unlimited times
explanation: You may exit the vehicle a maximum of two (2) times to check around the vehicle during Exercise 4.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.4 Exercise 4

question: What must be true about the vehicle's position when Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing is completed?
choice_a: The vehicle must be straight within the alley and completely within the defined exercise boundaries
choice_b: It may extend beyond the outer boundary line as long as it is straight
choice_c: Only the front of the vehicle needs to be within boundaries
choice_d: The vehicle may be at any angle as long as it clears the cones
explanation: Your vehicle must be straight within the alley when completed and completely within the defined exercise boundaries; you may not go beyond the outer boundary line.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.4 Exercise 4

question: During the on-road driving test, which of the following is required of every candidate?
choice_a: Exceed the posted speed limit slightly to keep up with traffic
choice_b: Only check mirrors when changing lanes
choice_c: Avoid stopping at any intersection
choice_d: Wear your safety belt and obey all traffic signs, signals, and laws
explanation: At all times during the test, you must drive in a safe and responsible manner, wear your safety belt, and obey all traffic signs, signals, and laws.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1 How You Will Be Tested

question: If your test route does not have a certain traffic situation, such as a railroad crossing, what may the examiner ask you to do?
choice_a: Skip that scoring category with no explanation
choice_b: Automatically fail you for an incomplete test
choice_c: Reschedule the entire test
choice_d: Simulate the traffic situation by telling the examiner what you are or would be doing
explanation: If your test route does not have certain traffic situations, you may be asked to simulate a traffic situation by telling the examiner what you are or would be doing.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1 How You Will Be Tested

question: What is considered "unsafe coasting" while approaching a turn?
choice_a: The vehicle being out of gear (clutch depressed or gearshift in neutral) for more than the length of the vehicle
choice_b: Braking before shifting
choice_c: Shifting gears at any point before the turn
choice_d: Using the turn signal too early
explanation: Unsafe coasting occurs when your vehicle is out of gear (clutch depressed or gearshift in neutral) for more than the length of your vehicle.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.1 Turns

question: If you must stop before making a turn, how should you stop?
choice_a: Anywhere within the intersection
choice_b: At least one car length past the stop sign
choice_c: Come to a smooth stop without skidding, behind the stop line, crosswalk, or stop sign
choice_d: As close to the corner as physically possible, regardless of markings
explanation: If you must stop before making the turn, come to a smooth stop without skidding, and stop behind the stop line, crosswalk, or stop sign.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.1 Turns

question: When stopping behind another vehicle, what does the manual describe as a "safe gap"?
choice_a: Being close enough to touch the vehicle ahead
choice_b: Stopping at least 50 feet behind any vehicle
choice_c: Leaving exactly two car lengths regardless of the vehicle ahead
choice_d: Being able to see the rear tires of the vehicle ahead of you
explanation: If stopping behind another vehicle, stop where you can see the rear tires on the vehicle ahead of you (safe gap).
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.1 Turns

question: After completing a turn, which of the following should you do?
choice_a: Immediately change lanes to the left
choice_b: Turn on your four-way flashers
choice_c: Make sure your turn signal is off and get up to the speed of traffic, using a turn signal to move into the right-most lane when safe
choice_d: Come to a complete stop to check your mirrors
explanation: After the turn, make sure your turn signal is off, get up to the speed of traffic, use a turn signal, and move into the right-most lane when safe to do so.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.1 Turns

question: As you approach an intersection, you should come to a complete stop (no coasting) behind any stop signs, signals, sidewalks, or stop lines while:
choice_a: Accelerating to clear the intersection quickly
choice_b: Turning off your headlights
choice_c: Maintaining a safe gap behind any vehicle in front of you
choice_d: Changing lanes to find the fastest path
explanation: If necessary, come to a complete stop (no coasting) behind any stop signs, signals, sidewalks, or stop lines, maintaining a safe gap behind any vehicle in front of you. Your vehicle must not roll forward or backward.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.2 Intersections

question: While driving through an intersection, which of the following should you NOT do?
choice_a: Check traffic thoroughly in all directions
choice_b: Change lanes while proceeding through the intersection
choice_c: Keep your hands on the wheel
choice_d: Decelerate and yield to pedestrians in the intersection
explanation: When driving through an intersection, do not change lanes while proceeding through the intersection.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.2 Intersections

question: During the Urban Business portion of the test, where should your vehicle be positioned?
choice_a: Straddling two lanes for visibility
choice_b: Centered in the proper (right-most) lane
choice_c: In the left-most lane to allow faster traffic to pass
choice_d: As far right as possible, including the shoulder
explanation: During Urban Business driving, your vehicle should be centered in the proper lane (right-most lane), keeping up with the flow of traffic but not exceeding the posted speed limit.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.3 Urban Business

question: When asked to change lanes during the multiple lane portion of the test, what should you do first?
choice_a: Make the necessary traffic checks first, then use proper signals and smoothly change lanes when safe
choice_b: Activate your signal immediately without checking traffic
choice_c: Honk to alert nearby drivers
choice_d: Accelerate hard to clear the lane quickly
explanation: During multiple lane portions of the test, you should make the necessary traffic checks first, then use proper signals and smoothly change lanes when it is safe to do so.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.4 Lane Changes

question: Once on the expressway, what must you continue to maintain?
choice_a: A speed at least 10 mph below the posted limit
choice_b: Constant lane changes to pass slower vehicles
choice_c: Proper lane positioning, vehicle spacing, and vehicle speed
explanation: Once on the expressway, you must maintain proper lane positioning, vehicle spacing, and vehicle speed, while continuing to check traffic thoroughly.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.5 Expressway or Rural/Limited Access Highway

question: When exiting the expressway, you must continue to decelerate:
choice_a: Within the lane markings while maintaining adequate spacing between your vehicle and other vehicles
choice_b: While accelerating to merge with cross traffic
choice_c: Only after leaving the exit ramp completely
explanation: Once on the exit ramp, you must continue to decelerate within the lane markings and maintain adequate spacing between your vehicle and other vehicles.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.5 Expressway or Rural/Limited Access Highway

question: For the Stop/Start maneuver, you are asked to pull your vehicle over as if you were going to:
choice_a: Refuel the vehicle
choice_b: Make a phone call
choice_c: Pick up a passenger
choice_d: Get out and check something on your vehicle
explanation: For the Stop/Start maneuver, you will be asked to pull your vehicle over to the side of the road and stop as if you were going to get out and check something on your vehicle.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.6 Stop/Start

question: Once stopped during the Stop/Start maneuver, which of the following should you do?
choice_a: Exit the vehicle immediately
choice_b: Activate your four-way emergency flashers and apply the parking brake
choice_c: Keep your right turn signal on indefinitely
choice_d: Leave the vehicle in drive with your foot on the brake
explanation: Once stopped, you must cancel your turn signal, activate your four-way emergency flashers, apply the parking brake, move the gear shift to neutral or park, and remove your feet from the brake and clutch pedals.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.6 Stop/Start

question: When resuming from the Stop/Start maneuver, what should you do before pulling back into traffic?
choice_a: Turn the steering wheel before the vehicle moves
choice_b: Turn off your four-way flashers, activate the left turn signal, and check traffic thoroughly, especially to the left
choice_c: Wait for another vehicle to signal you to proceed
choice_d: Immediately release the parking brake and accelerate hard
explanation: When instructed to resume, check traffic and mirrors, turn off your four-way flashers, activate the left turn signal, and when traffic permits, release the parking brake and pull straight ahead, checking traffic from all directions, especially to the left, without turning the wheel before the vehicle moves.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.6 Stop/Start

question: Before entering a curve, what should you do?
choice_a: Change lanes to get the best angle through the curve
choice_b: Accelerate to maintain momentum through the curve
choice_c: Reduce speed so further braking or shifting is not required in the curve
choice_d: Shift to neutral to coast through the curve
explanation: Before entering the curve, reduce speed so that further braking or shifting is not required in the curve, and keep the vehicle in the lane.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.7 Curve

question: While any part of your vehicle is in a railroad crossing, what must you NOT do?
choice_a: Look and listen for trains before entering
choice_b: Stop, change gears, pass another vehicle, or change lanes
choice_c: Keep your hands on the steering wheel
explanation: Do not stop, change gears, pass another vehicle, or change lanes while any part of your vehicle is in the crossing.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.8 Railroad Crossing

topic: On-Road Test Procedures - Railroad Crossing (Bus/Placarded Vehicles)
question: A bus, school bus, or vehicle displaying placards must stop within how many feet, but not less than how many feet, from the nearest rail at a railroad crossing?
choice_a: Within 100 feet, but not less than 50 feet
choice_b: Within 25 feet, but not less than 5 feet
choice_c: Within 50 feet, but not less than 15 feet
choice_d: Within 15 feet, but not less than 5 feet
explanation: The manual states such vehicles must stop the vehicle within 50 feet but not less than 15 feet from the nearest rail.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.8 Railroad Crossing

topic: On-Road Test Procedures - Railroad Crossing (Bus/Placarded Vehicles)
question: As a bus, school bus, or placarded vehicle approaches a railroad crossing, what should the driver activate?
choice_a: The stop arm
choice_b: The horn continuously
choice_c: The high beam headlights
explanation: As the vehicle approaches a railroad crossing, activate the four-way flashers; they should be deactivated after the vehicle crosses the tracks.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.8 Railroad Crossing

question: After driving under an overpass, the examiner may ask you to tell them:
choice_a: The posted clearance or height
choice_b: The speed limit on the overpass
choice_c: The posted weight limit
choice_d: The name of the road crossing overhead
explanation: After driving under an overpass, you may be asked to tell the examiner what the posted clearance or height was.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.9 Bridge/Overpass/Sign

question: After going over a bridge, the examiner may ask you to tell them:
choice_a: The length of the bridge
choice_b: The construction date of the bridge
choice_c: The number of lanes on the bridge
explanation: After going over a bridge, you may be asked to tell the examiner what the posted weight limit was.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.9 Bridge/Overpass/Sign

topic: On-Road Test Procedures - Student Discharge (School Bus)
question: As you stop for a student discharge, how far away from students at the stop must the school bus come to a complete stop?
choice_a: At least 10 feet
choice_b: At least 5 feet
choice_c: At least 50 feet
explanation: As you stop for the student discharge, you must bring the school bus to a complete stop at least 10' away from students at the stop.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.10 Student Discharge (School Bus)

topic: On-Road Test Procedures - Student Discharge (School Bus)
question: When approaching a student pick up, which lights and signals must be activated?
choice_a: Four-way flashers only
choice_b: High beam headlights
choice_c: Amber warning lights and the right turn signal
explanation: As you approach the student pick up, you must activate amber warning lights and the right turn signal, and move as far as possible to the right on the traveled portion of the roadway.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.10 Student Discharge (School Bus)

topic: On-Road Test Procedures - Student Discharge (School Bus)
question: When students are crossing during a school bus discharge, what must the driver do?
choice_a: Check traffic, communicate to students, and check for students
choice_b: Close the door and turn off warning lights
choice_c: Sound the horn repeatedly
explanation: When students are crossing, you must check traffic, communicate to students, and check for students.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.10 Student Discharge (School Bus)

topic: On-Road Test Procedures - Student Discharge (School Bus)
question: When stopping for a student discharge, in addition to placing the transmission in neutral/park and setting the parking brake, what must you activate?
choice_a: The stop arm and red warning lights
choice_b: The high beam headlights
choice_c: The amber warning lights only
explanation: As you stop for the student discharge, you must place the transmission in neutral/park, set the parking brake, and activate the stop arm and red warning lights.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.10 Student Discharge (School Bus)

question: If a manual transmission vehicle is equipped with an unsynchronized transmission, what must the driver do when shifting?
choice_a: Coast with the clutch depressed
choice_b: Double-clutch when shifting
choice_c: Single-clutch quickly
explanation: If equipped with an unsynchronized manual transmission, you must double-clutch when shifting, and must not rev or lug the engine.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.11(a) Clutch Usage

question: Which of the following is a prohibited clutch practice according to the manual?
choice_a: Using the clutch to shift gears
choice_b: Riding the clutch to control speed
choice_c: Double-clutching an unsynchronized transmission
choice_d: Fully depressing the clutch during a gear change
explanation: The manual states you should not ride the clutch to control speed, coast with the clutch depressed, or "pop" the clutch.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.11(a) Clutch Usage

question: According to the manual's gear usage guidance, drivers should NOT:
choice_a: Use the clutch when shifting
choice_b: Shift in turns and intersections
choice_c: Change gears while decelerating for a stop
choice_d: Select a gear that avoids revving or lugging the engine
explanation: For gear usage, the manual states: do not grind or clash gears, select a gear that does not rev or lug the engine, and do not shift in turns and intersections.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.12(b) Gear Usage

question: According to the manual, proper brake usage means you should:
choice_a: Brake smoothly using steady pressure, and not ride or pump the brake
choice_b: Brake harshly when approaching a stop
choice_c: Pump the brakes frequently for better control
choice_d: Apply the brake and clutch simultaneously at all times
explanation: For brake usage, the manual states: do not ride or pump the brake; do not brake harshly; brake smoothly using steady pressure.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.13(c) Brake Usage

question: When completing a left turn on a multiple lane road, where should the vehicle finish?
choice_a: In the lane directly to the right of the center line
choice_b: Straddling both lanes
choice_c: In the far right (curb) lane
choice_d: In the far left lane, regardless of direction
explanation: The manual states you should complete a turn in the proper lane on a multiple lane road (vehicle should finish a left turn in the lane directly to the right of the center line).
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.14(d) Lane Usage

question: Where should a right turn be finished, according to the manual's lane usage guidance?
choice_a: In the left-most lane
choice_b: In the lane directly to the right of the center line
choice_c: In any legal lane
explanation: The manual instructs you to finish a right turn in the right-most (curb) lane, and to move to or remain in the right-most lane unless it is blocked.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.14(d) Lane Usage

question: According to the manual's steering guidance, when is it acceptable to take a hand off the steering wheel?
choice_a: Whenever checking a mirror
choice_b: Whenever reaching for the turn signal
choice_c: Only when shifting, then both hands should return to the wheel
explanation: You must keep both hands on the steering wheel at all times unless shifting; once you have completed the shift, return both hands to the steering wheel.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.15 Steering

topic: General Driving Behaviors - Regular Traffic Checks
question: According to the manual, when should you check your mirrors and traffic in relation to an intersection?
choice_a: Only if a pedestrian is visible
choice_b: Only when changing lanes
choice_c: Only after passing through it
choice_d: Before, while in, and after the intersection
explanation: The manual states to check mirrors and traffic before, while in, and after an intersection, and to scan for traffic in high-volume areas and areas where pedestrians are expected.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.16 Regular Traffic Checks

topic: General Driving Behaviors - Use of Turn Signals
question: When should turn signals be canceled, according to the manual?
choice_a: Turn signals should never be canceled manually
choice_b: Upon completion of a turn or lane change
choice_c: Only when another driver flashes their lights at you
explanation: The manual states to cancel turn signals upon completion of a turn or lane change, and to activate them properly and at appropriate times.
source_note: Missouri Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-Road Driving, 13.1.17 Use of Turn Signals
